title: Unnamed Southern California facility storing non-human bodies

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. A place out in California. Oh, an unnamed place. A place that doesn't have its own designation.
hey the bodies are st stored over there in California
tellings.link_reason: Both are the same teller's claim that non-human bodies are stored at an unnamed place in California.

plain: Non-human bodies are said to be stored at a place in California that has no official name or designation. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this as what a source he does not name told him, saying "the bodies are stored over there in California" and that it is "a place that doesn't have its own designation"; in one telling it is Southern California, in another just California. If true, the government would be keeping physical remains of non-human beings at a hidden site.
